name: 32220 · Jacksonville, FL
findings: ZIP 32220 (Jacksonville) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32220 (Jacksonville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32220 (Jacksonville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).
